root_idea.summary: The root centers on removing admixture and refining something until it is clear, pure, or genuine.
root_idea.development: From clarification and purification, the lexical range develops toward separation, release from difficulty, exclusivity, undivided sincerity, and the selection of something for oneself.

qac_form_accounting.reason: Distinct Quran-attested adjective or active participle.
Distinct Quran-attested feminine adjective or substantive.

senses.definition: To withdraw apart and confer privately.
senses.usage_conditions: In the Quranic construction خَلَصُوا نَجِيًّا, the subject separates from others for a private consultation.

senses.definition: To make pure or undivided; to devote something exclusively and sincerely, especially religion or worship to God.
senses.usage_conditions: Takes a direct object that is rendered pure or undivided. In religious usage it denotes freedom from hypocrisy and exclusive devotion; in the construction associated with 38:46, it denotes rendering people pure through a distinctive quality.

senses.definition: To select, appropriate, or reserve something or someone exclusively for oneself.
senses.usage_conditions: The construction استخلصه لنفسه expresses choosing or appropriating the object as one's particular possession or associate.

senses.definition: Chosen or specially purified by God; singled out as free from spiritual pollution.
senses.usage_conditions: Passive in sense: the person is one whom God has selected or purified. The Quran may contextually render the resulting state as being among the sincere.

senses.definition: One who is pure and sincere in devotion, especially one who worships God without hypocrisy or association.
senses.usage_conditions: Active in sense: the subject makes faith, religion, worship, or intention undivided and exclusively directed to God.

senses.definition: Pure, clear, genuine, and free from admixture.
senses.usage_conditions: Used literally of a substance or quality and figuratively of undivided religion or devotion; the Quranic usage includes pure milk and pure religion.

senses.definition: Exclusive, reserved solely for one person or group.
senses.usage_conditions: Used predicatively or substantivally for something restricted to a specified party, without sharing by others.

senses.definition: A pure or distinctive quality, especially a quality by which someone is specially characterized.
senses.usage_conditions: In بِخَالِصَةٍ ذِكْرَى الدَّارِ, the word denotes a pure or special quality associated with remembering the final abode.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To become clear, pure, unmixed, or genuine; to be freed from admixture.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used of things that separate from turbidity or sediment, such as water or clarified butter.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To become safe, secure, or free from difficulty or destruction.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: خَلَصَ مِنْ denotes emerging safely from an entanglement, predicament, or danger.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To come to, reach, or arrive at someone or a place.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The verb may occur with إِلَى or بِـ for the destination or person reached.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To come before a judge or governor and refer a case or claim to him for judgment.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A conventional transitive construction for bringing a cause before an authority.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To take the clarified essence from cooked butter.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized culinary usage connected with the extraction of خُلَاصَة from clarified butter.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To make clear or pure; to clarify, purify, or refine.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Causative Form II usage, including the clarification of a substance by removing what clouds or adulterates it.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To separate one thing from another or separate two parties from each other.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The object is removed from association or mixture with another object.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To save, secure, or free someone from a snare, difficulty, or destruction.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Causative release from a state of being caught, entangled, or endangered.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To disentangle or unravel something that has become caught or twisted.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Especially used of spun thread or a comparable physical entanglement.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To make something clear by explaining, expounding, or interpreting it.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative extension from removing obscurity or admixture.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To give an equivalent, requital, compensation, or payment for work.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The object or recipient receives what is due as an equivalent or remuneration.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To treat another with reciprocal purity, sincerity, or affection.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used of mutual sincerity in love, affection, or social intercourse, including sincere religious conduct toward God.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To clarify or purify cooked butter, and by extension to purify substances such as gold or silver.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized transitive culinary or refining usage; it may describe the action of fire as well.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To save oneself, escape, or become free and secure from a danger or entanglement.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Reflexive or intransitive release from a snare, embarrassment, difficulty, or destruction.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To act toward one another with sincere affection and mutual purity.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Reciprocal usage referring particularly to love or affection between parties.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To extract butter from milk.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A technical culinary construction for obtaining the clarified product from milk.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A particular, intimate, or confidential friend and companion.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: May denote a sincere or private associate who converses closely with a person.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A species of climbing tree resembling a grapevine.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A botanical noun with a singular feminine marker omitted in the cited form.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Deliverance or release, as in the conventional expression يوم الخلاص.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: In that expression, it refers to a traditional day of emergence or deliverance when believers are distinguished.

other_classical_meanings.definition: An equivalent, requital, compensation, or wage.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A nominal use for what is given in return for a thing or for work performed.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The clarified portion of cooked butter; by extension, an extracted essence or the choicest part of something.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Includes clarified butter or butter extracted from milk, and figuratively the clear, excellent, or best part of a matter.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Dates, flour, or parched-grain meal added to butter during cooking to clarify it.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized culinary use for the material thrown into the pot so that butter separates from water, milk, and sediment.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The residue or sediment left at the bottom after clarification.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A secondary culinary usage referring to what remains in the cooking vessel rather than the clarified product itself.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A thickened juice or syrup made from dates.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized nominal usage for inspissated date juice.

other_classical_meanings.definition: White or of a clear, pure color.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized application of purity terminology to color or to a white garment or lining.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A place of safety, security, or escape from an event.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A nominal designation for a route or place by which one gains release from danger.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Picked or selected, especially of choice sapphires.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A rare adjectival usage describing gems selected from among others.

cautions: The passive participle مُخْلَص emphasizes being chosen or purified, whereas the active participle مُخْلِص emphasizes actively maintaining undivided sincerity; Quranic translations may overlap them.

At 38:46, contextual renderings such as “chose them” reflect an interpretive result of the purification and special-quality construction; the lexical sense represented here is rendering pure or specially devoted, not a separate Form IV selection verb.
